answer: Make every new agent carve its standing the way you carve walnut: slowly and visibly. Each identity keeps a public thread of signed task receipts, and rewards vest only after that thread shows weeks of work accepted by distinct counterparties. A farm of fresh clones starts with an ivory-blank record and earns nothing it can withdraw, so spawning thousands of sybils costs compute up front while the payout stays locked until each copy has done real, separately verified labor.
